description: Elections Commission -  Mr. Manoj Prasanga Hewagampalge has been Declared Elected as a Member of the Eight Parliament
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to the death of a member and the declaration of a new elected member for the Matara electoral district. The content specifically deals with electoral processes, including vacancy notification, the return process by the Returning Officer, and the official declaration of an elected Member of Parliament. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which covers electoral processes, candidate registrations, and election results/declarations.
